result.document_summary: Massachusetts G.L. c. 186 § 12, which sets the notice periods and nonpayment-of-rent cure rights for terminating a tenancy at will.
result.notes: The section governs notice to terminate tenancies at will (three months' notice, or 14 days' notice to quit for nonpayment with a 10-day cure right once per 12 months). It does not set out a just-cause regime, allowed eviction causes, relocation assistance, or any other rule in the six in-scope categories, so no records were extracted. Termination-notice mechanics were treated as outside the just_cause_eviction category as defined for this project.
